ABOUT ME / BUILDING & GIVING BACK

Curiosity, put to work.

I'm Pranav, a Computer Science junior at UCF, graduating in May 2028. I build cloud systems, full-stack applications, and applied AI with a focus on the people using them.

Giving back to the tech community matters to me. As SASE's CS Tech Chair, I lead the web team; as AI@UCF Projects Director, I oversee the club's AI projects and help students turn ideas into working software.
